The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that – it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets – a connected ERP for private capital.

The Problems You’ll Solve

As an Implementations Accountant, you will focus efforts on supporting new Fund Administration customers in their journey into Carta services. You will drive operational excellence within our fast-growing Fund Administration business by coordinating, facilitating and managing onboarding activities that are critical to achieving success for both our customers and Carta within a tight deadline.

In this role you will be responsible for interacting with a fund’s back office (CFO, fund manager) to collect their historical data, provide advisory support, and ultimately deliver accurate financial statements to both the client and internal stakeholders.

From sale close, to implementation, and continued customer success, the ideal Implementations Accountant will exhibit a high degree of problem-solving, efficiency, and integrity as they leverage their subject‑matter expertise to provide customers with a world‑class onboarding experience.

The Impact You’ll Have

  • Collaborate with new fund clients to collect data and advise on best accounting practices within Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
  • Effectively liaise between sales and Fund Accounting teams as the bridge post‑sales
  • Identify process and quality improvements and highlight them to appropriate leadership
  • Create balanced, accurate quarterly financial statements from, at times, unstructured client data
  • Project manage and delegate to internal teams and collaborators located across the globe

About You

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field, or equivalent experience
  • 1+ years of experience in a role with a finance or accounting background
  • Strong accounting analysis with the ability to interpret a story through unstructured data
  • Committed to team and project success, emotionally intelligent in navigating relationships, transparent and forthright when communicating information, and passionate about growing and advancing with Carta
  • Proven internal influencer having implemented and successfully managed both small and large projects or initiatives with sustained, measurable success
  • Incredible organizational skills, high attention to detail, and an ability to complete competing priorities quickly and autonomously
  • Ability to communicate in both written and verbal formats in a timely and appropriate manner
  • Fluent in English, both written and verbal

Nice‑to‑Haves

  • Acumen in or knowledge of accounting with a specific focus in venture, hedge fund, and/or private equity
  • Familiarity as an end user with Carta or other financial dataset or accounting software programs

description:
Manager, Volunteer System

Department: Events & Entertainment

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer System Manager will play a key role in shaping and managing the volunteer journey through the FIFA Volunteer Platform, supporting operations across eight Host Cities within the Integrated Model.

The purpose of this role is to lead the set‑up, operation, and maintenance of the FIFA Volunteer Platform, which serves as the foundation for the entire volunteer experience. The successful candidate will also oversee essential system integrations to ensure a seamless, efficient, and high‑quality operational process for the tournament. This role will work in close collaboration with the Volunteer Management Teams at FIFA Zurich, FIFA27, Host Cities in Brazil and the FIFA Volunteer Platform provider, as well as with other Functional Areas, to ensure the technology platforms meet all operational requirements while supporting the successful delivery of the Volunteer Programme.

We are seeking an innovative and experienced systems professional with a proven record in managing complex, large‑scale event operations. The ideal candidate will join a dynamic, multicultural environment and bring both strategic insight and firsthand expertise to one of the most exciting sporting events in the world.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Work on development of all system processes in the FIFA volunteer platform, from application through to tournament‑time management, including test events and satellite events
  • Participate in the planning phase to finalise configuration of the FIFA Volunteer Platform ensuring it fully supports the requirements of the Integrated Model for a consistent volunteer experience and operational processes across all Host Cities.
  • Support the review and refine system functionalities to meet the evolving needs of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Ensure operational readiness to test and finalise the application form for the Volunteer Programme launch.
  • Ensure integration with other FIFA and local systems, managing all dependencies.
  • Act as the volunteer department’s main point of contact for User Access, User Validation, UAT (User Acceptance Testing), and system simulations.
  • Identify and propose technical solutions to operational challenges not addressed by existing functionality.
  • Ensure data integrity, compliance, and security across all volunteer systems in‑line with FIFA’s data protection standards.
  • Act as the first point of escalation and resolution for volunteer system issues.
  • Promote best practices in data management, analytics, and system governance.
  • Lead the creation of data reports, dashboards, and analytical tools for operational insights and decision‑making.
  • Monitor and report on project timelines, change requests, and system risks in line with the integrated volunteer systems plan.
  • Establish clear reporting and monitoring processes to evaluate programme effectiveness, volunteer satisfaction, and service delivery.
  • Lead the preparation and delivery of training materials and conduct “Train‑The‑Trainer” sessions for system users.
  • Ensure compliance to the FIFA tournament guidelines and oversee project execution in alignment with the approved budget, identifying efficiencies and cost‑effective delivery methods.
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of an International Volunteer Welcome Strategy, including logistics, visa facilitation, and cultural integration.
  • Ensure a structured systems close‑out process, including comprehensive handover and debrief report.
  • Represent the Volunteer team in cross‑functional area meetings, host city briefings, readiness workshops, stakeholder engagements, and strategic planning.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in large‑scale volunteer, workforce, or sport event programme management.
  • Education: Master’s in Sports Management or Event Management or Technology, Information Systems, or Project Management preferred.
  • Proven experience managing large‑scale technology or systems implementation projects.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and project management skills.
  • Strong analytical and reporting skills, including proficiency with data visualisation and business intelligence tools.
  • High cultural awareness with experience in multi‑stakeholder and multicultural environments.
  • Training delivery experience a plus
  • Familiarity with volunteer management systems (Rosterfy) and related IT tools is highly desirable.
  • Ability to be flexible and adopt an innovative mindset
  • Team player with internal and external stakeholders
  • Ability to thrive in an international, dynamic, and fast‑paced environment.
  • Collaborative and empathetic team player, passionate about community‑building, sport, and service.
  • Creativity and resourcefulness to enhance the volunteer experience and drive engagement.
  • Anticipates needs, understands the strategic impact of systems, and drives continuous improvement.
  • Project management or Systems Management certification is desired
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Olá, somos a Teamsoft, uma fábrica de software que visa sempre o aprendizado contínuo e evolução profissional. Somos apaixonados por desenvolver soluções que fazem a diferença na vida das pessoas. Conhecimento técnico é muito importante, mas acima de tudo, buscamos pessoas que queiram crescer e se desenvolver junto conosco.

Sonhamos alto e apostamos muito no nosso DreamTeam, somos uma empresa descolada e que preza pela Comunicação, Transparência e Objetividade. Comunicação – Somos Remote First e, para isso, precisamos manter a comunicação sempre. Transparência – Sinceridade é essencial para manter a qualidade dos nossos projetos e time. Objetividade – Aqui não temos Mimimi, somos objetivos e buscamos solucionar tudo da melhor forma.

Quem buscamos

  • Pessoas com excelente organização e cumprimento de prazos
  • Pessoas que sejam extremamente curiosas e desejam aprender
  • Pessoas que buscam conhecimento e trazem novas soluções
  • Senso de urgência e mentalidade de dono
  • Gostar de desafios e estar aberto a mudanças
  • Boa comunicação e respeito à diversidade de pensamento

Atividades principais

  • Planejamento Estratégico: Desenvolver e conduzir o planejamento estratégico de marketing, definindo objetivos, posicionamento, linhas editoriais e pilares de conteúdo alinhados às metas de negócio da empresa.
  • Planejamento de Calendário Editorial: Estruturar e organizar o calendário de postagens considerando campanhas, sazonalidades e metas de comunicação.
  • Captação de Conteúdo: Participar ativamente de eventos, reuniões, bastidores e demais oportunidades para registrar materiais (fotos, vídeos, depoimentos) que possam ser transformados em conteúdo digital.
  • Gestão de Conteúdo: Criar, programar e publicar conteúdos criativos e relevantes alinhados ao posicionamento da marca.
  • Criação e Edição de Conteúdo Multimídia: Apoiar na produção de textos, imagens, vídeos, reels e stories adaptados a cada rede social.
  • Engajamento com a Comunidade: Monitorar interações, responder comentários e mensagens, fortalecendo o relacionamento com os seguidores.
  • Monitoramento e Análise de Resultados: Acompanhar métricas de desempenho (alcance, engajamento, conversões) e gerar relatórios periódicos.
  • Tendências e Inovação: Identificar oportunidades e propor novas abordagens criativas baseadas em tendências de social media.
  • Colaboração com a Equipe de Marketing: Trabalhar em conjunto com designers, redatores, analistas e equipe de produto para garantir a consistência da comunicação digital.

Observação importante: É necessário disponibilidade para realizar captações de conteúdo fora do horário comercial, principalmente em clientes do segmento de bares e restaurantes, devido à natureza das operações.

Principais conhecimentos

  • Captação de conteúdo com celular ou equipamentos básicos, com noções de enquadramento, iluminação e registro estratégico de momentos relevantes, incluindo eventos e ativações de marca.
  • Experiência na gestão de redes sociais (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok e YouTube), entendendo público, formatos e objetivos de cada canal.
  • Conhecimento em planejamento de marketing, com definição de personas, posicionamento, proposta de valor, jornada do cliente e funil de comunicação.
  • Atuação no suporte e organização de eventos presenciais e ações promocionais, envolvendo divulgação, cobertura digital e aproveitamento estratégico de conteúdo.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em conjunto com áreas criativas e de mídia, garantindo alinhamento estratégico e consistência da marca.
  • Noções de briefing criativo, direcionamento de peças gráficas e materiais institucionais.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de agendamento e monitoramento (Meta Business Suite, Hootsuite, mLabs ou similares).
  • Capacidade analítica para interpretar métricas (engajamento, leads, conversões, CAC e ROI) e gerar recomendações estratégicas.
  • Habilidade em redação estratégica e copywriting, adaptando linguagem para branding, relacionamento ou vendas.
  • Organização e visão sistêmica para conectar social media com outras frentes de marketing, como landing pages, e‑mail marketing, mídia paga, eventos e ações comerciais.

Conhecimentos que fazem a diferença

  • Experiência com marketing de influência.
  • Noções de SEO aplicado a redes sociais e YouTube.
  • Conhecimento em estratégias de growth e viralização.
  • Conhecimentos básicos de design (Canva, Photoshop ou similares) e edição de vídeo (Premiere, CapCut ou similares).

Benefícios

  • Telemedicina
  • Pronto atendimento 24h online
  • Terapias (nutrição, psicólogo)
  • Descontos em farmácias, tratamentos odontológicos e cirurgias
  • Descontos em vacinas e exames laboratoriais e de imagem
  • Gympass
  • Day Off de aniversário
  • Descanso remunerado
  • Let's Play (Auxílio para equipamentos)
  • Programa de Indicação Premiada

Modelo de Contratação

  • Contrato: PJ
  • Híbrido (2 dias presenciais, 3 dias remoto)

title: Engineering Job Leader – Elétrica
description:
Quem somos

A Longitude é uma consultoria internacional independente de design e engenharia , especializada em projetos nos setores de energia, marítimo, naval, offshore e renováveis . Parte do ABL Group , atuamos globalmente apoiando clientes ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida de ativos complexos, sempre com foco em segurança, excelência técnica, inovação e sustentabilidade .

Com uma atuação integrada globalmente, a Longitude conta também com um time no Brasil , que trabalha de forma colaborativa com equipes internacionais, conectando expertise local ao know-how global do grupo.

Nossa missão, visão e valores

? Missão
Entregar soluções de engenharia confiáveis e eficientes, apoiando nossos clientes na execução de projetos complexos com alto padrão técnico e segurança.

?️ Visão
Ser referência global em engenharia marítima e offshore, reconhecida pela qualidade, inovação e desenvolvimento de pessoas.

? Valores

  • Safety first – segurança sempre em primeiro lugar
  • Technical excellence – qualidade e precisão técnica
  • Collaboration – trabalho em equipe e relações de confiança
  • Innovation – melhoria contínua e soluções inteligentes
  • Integrity & transparency – ética, clareza e responsabilidade

Sobre a vaga

Você atuará como Engineering Job Leader da disciplina Elétrica , sendo o responsável técnico direto pelo desenvolvimento, coordenação e qualidade das entregas de engenharia elétrica em projetos offshore .

Além da atuação nos projetos locais, o profissional interagirá ativamente com projetos da Longitude ao redor do mundo , colaborando com equipes globais no compartilhamento de experiências, conhecimento técnico e melhores práticas , bem como prestando suporte técnico a projetos internacionais , fortalecendo a excelência técnica e a padronização global da disciplina elétrica.

Principais Responsabilidades

⚡ Liderar tecnicamente a disciplina elétrica , definindo escopo, prioridades, estratégias de execução e padrões técnicos dos projetos.

? Desenvolver, revisar e aprovar documentos e estudos elétricos , incluindo Single Line Diagrams (SLDs) , listas de carga, estudos de curto-circuito, arco elétrico, coordenação e harmônicos .

✅ Revisar, validar e aprovar tecnicamente os entregáveis elétricos produzidos por equipes internas ou empresas subcontratadas, atuando como autoridade técnica da disciplina .

? Garantir a conformidade com normas técnicas , regulamentos aplicáveis e requisitos de sociedades classificadoras (ABS, DNV, BV, entre outras).

? Gerenciar interfaces técnicas com outras disciplinas (Processo, Instrumentação, Naval, Estrutural, Automação), assegurando integração e consistência do projeto.

? Atuar como ponto focal técnico junto ao cliente , participando de reuniões técnicas, análises críticas e tomada de decisões.

? Colaborar com equipes globais da Longitude , apoiando projetos internacionais e promovendo padronização, melhoria contínua e compartilhamento de conhecimento técnico .

Requisitos

? Formação Acadêmica
Graduação completa em Engenharia Elétrica ou áreas correlatas.

⚡ Experiência Profissional
Experiência sólida em engenharia elétrica aplicada a projetos offshore , preferencialmente em FPSOs e plataformas de produção e experiência prévia atuando como referência técnica ou líder técnico da disciplina elétrica .

? Conhecimentos Técnicos
Conhecimento aprofundado de normas técnicas internacionais (IEC, IEEE, API, NORSOK) e requisitos de sociedades classificadoras.

? Ferramentas e Sistemas
Experiência com softwares de estudos elétricos (ex.: ETAP, SKM, PowerFactory ou similares).

? Idiomas
Inglês fluente (obrigatório), com capacidade de comunicação técnica em ambiente internacional.

✈️ Disponibilidade
Disponibilidade para viagens e embarques eventuais , reuniões presenciais e suporte técnico a projetos onshore e offshore.

Diferenciais

⭐ Experiência em projetos internacionais ou atuação em ambientes multiculturais.
⭐ Vivência com FPSOs e unidades de produção offshore.
⭐ Conhecimento avançado emsegurança elétrica , estudos de arco elétrico e classificação de áreas.

O que oferecemos para você

? VA, VR e VT pagos no Cartão Flash com flexibilidade de uso.
? Plano de saúde e odontológico extensíveis a dependentes sem desconto .
? Modelo híbrido de trabalho e horário flexível .
? Plano de carreira estruturado , com possibilidade de promoção a cada 6 meses , conforme avaliação de desempenho.
?️ Seguro de vida .
? Interface constante com times internacionais , promovendo trocas globais de conhecimento.
? Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI) , com possibilidade de custeio de cursos e certificações pela empresa .
? Acesso gratuito à ABL Academy , com amplo portfólio de cursos técnicos.
?️ Aulas gratuitas de inglês e espanhol , com professora no escritório.
?️ Wellhub (Gympass) para saúde física e bem-estar.
? Auxílio-creche para crianças até 6 anos .
? Ambiente técnico, colaborativo e internacional, com foco em excelência e desenvolvimento contínuo.

description:
Overview

Somos distribuidor autorizado Moove para Lubrificantes Mobil, com atuação no mercado automotivo e industrial do Rio de Janeiro e Espírito Santo.

O Vendedor Externo de Consumo é responsável por realizar visitas periódicas aos clientes da carteira, prospectar novos clientes e apresentar o portfólio de produtos da empresa, destacando suas características e benefícios. Além disso, deve negociar condições de venda, preços e prazos de entrega conforme as diretrizes da Rodolub, contribuindo para o crescimento e expansão do mercado.

Responsabilidades

  • Realizar visitas regulares e manter uma comunicação eficaz para expandir a carteira de clientes existente.
  • Reportar possíveis irregularidades no processo de vendas e tomar medidas para corrigir ações não autorizadas.
  • Utilizar iPad e telefone fornecidos pela empresa para registrar todas as atividades de vendas e interações com clientes.
  • Identificar e contatar potenciais clientes na região designada.
  • Apresentar o portfólio de produtos da empresa, destacando suas características e benefícios.
  • Negociar condições de venda, preços e prazos de entrega de acordo com as diretrizes da empresa.
  • Acompanhar os pedidos e entregas para garantir a satisfação do cliente.
  • Desenvolver e implementar planos de vendas para atingir metas estabelecidas. Preparar relatórios de vendas, incluindo Forecast e Funil de Vendas, e fazer previsões de mercado.
  • Zelar pelos ativos da companhia e proteger informações classificadas como restritas.

Requisitos

  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar seu próprio tempo.
  • Experiência prévia em vendas externas, preferencialmente no setor de lubrificantes ou produtos automotivos.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita.

A JDE Peet’s é uma empresa líder mundial especializada em cafés e chás, sediada na Holanda e com uma história que começou em 1753. At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective human intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform, launched and powered by Toloka, connects domain experts with cutting‑edge AI projects from innovative tech clients. Our mission is to unlock the potential of GenAI by tapping into real‑world expertise from across the globe.

Who we’re looking for

We’re looking for curious and intellectually proactive contributors, the kind of person who double‑checks assumptions and plays devil’s advocate. Are you comfortable with ambiguity and complexity? Does an async, remote, flexible opportunity sound exciting? Would you like to learn how modern AI systems are tested and evaluated?

  • Analysts, researchers, or consultants with strong critical thinking skills
  • Students (senior undergrads / grad students) looking for an intellectually interesting gig
  • People open to a part‑time and non‑permanent opportunity

About the Project

We’re on the hunt for QAs for autonomous AI agents for a new project focused on validating and improving complex task structures, policy logic, and agent evaluation frameworks. Throughout the project, you’ll have to balance quality assurance, research, and logical problem‑solving. This project opportunity is ideal for people who enjoy looking at systems holistically and thinking through scenarios, implications, and edge cases.

You do not need a coding background, but you must be curious, intellectually rigorous, and capable of evaluating the soundness and consistency of complex setups. If you’ve ever excelled in things like consulting, CHGK, Olympiads, case solving, or systems thinking — you might be a great fit.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Reviewing evaluation tasks and scenarios for logic, completeness, and realism
  • Identifying inconsistencies, missing assumptions, or unclear decision points
  • Helping define clear expected behaviors (gold standards) for AI agents
  • Annotating cause‑effect relationships, reasoning paths, and plausible alternatives
  • Thinking through complex systems and policies as a human would to ensure agents are tested properly
  • Working closely with QA, writers, or developers to suggest refinements or edge case coverage

How to Get Started

Apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to a project aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. Shape the future of AI while building tools that benefit everyone.

Requirements

  • Excellent analytical thinking: Can reason about complex systems, scenarios, and logical implications
  • Strong attention to detail: Can spot contradictions, ambiguities, and vague requirements
  • Familiarity with structured data formats: Can read, not necessarily write JSON/YAML
  • Ability to assess scenarios holistically: What’s missing, what’s unrealistic, what might break?
  • Good communication and clear writing (in English) to document your findings.

We also value applicants who have:

  • Experience with policy evaluation, logic puzzles, case studies, or structured scenario design
  • Background in consulting, academia, olympiads (e.g. logic/math/informatics), or research
  • Exposure to LLMs, prompt engineering, or AI‑generated content
  • Familiarity with QA or test‑case thinking (edge cases, failure modes, "what could go wrong")
  • Some understanding of how scoring or evaluation works in agent testing (precision, coverage, etc.)

Benefits

  • Get paid for your expertise, with rates that can go up to $17/hour depending on your skills, experience, and project needs
  • Take part in a flexible, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments
  • Participate in an advanced AI project and gain valuable experience to enhance your portfolio
  • Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise

The Cleaning and Waste Management Coordinator will support the Senior Cleaning and Waste Management Manager in the planning, operational readiness, implementation, and monitoring of cleaning and waste management operations across FIFA Official Sites. The role supports waste minimisation by reviewing and assessing procurement and service contracts and contributes to achieving defined waste diversion targets.

The position is execution-focused and site-oriented, responsible for supporting readiness planning, coordinating day-to-day operations, and monitoring service delivery during test events and tournament operations. The CLW Coordinator plays a key role in translating strategic and functional requirements into practical, on-the-ground execution, ensuring operational continuity, compliance with FIFA requirements, and the timely identification and resolution of issues at the venue level.

The ideal candidate will combine expertise in event operations, sustainable cleaning, and waste management with strong project management skills. This role will focus on optimizing operational efficiency, ensuring stakeholder satisfaction, and minimizing environmental impact while adhering to FIFA’s stringent standards.

Key responsibilities

Planning & Operational Readiness

  • Support the development and readiness planning of cleaning and waste management operational plans across stadiums and other FIFA Official Sites.
  • Contribute to Service Level Agreement (SLA) development and alignment with Functional Area (FA) leads, ensuring requirements are clearly defined, operationally feasible, and venue-ready.
  • Support Service Level Requirement (SLR) alignment with stadium facility management teams, ensuring consistency with existing venue operations, infrastructure, and constraints.
  • Participate in readiness assessments, site walk-throughs, and test events to validate operational plans, staffing levels, infrastructure, and service flows.

Operational Coordination & Delivery

  • Coordinate day-to-day cleaning and waste management operations in line with approved operational plans, service levels, and schedules.
  • Support match-day, non-match-day, and peak-load operations to ensure service continuity and operational effectiveness.
  • Monitor contractor performance on site and report deviations, risks, and non-compliance to the Senior Cleaning and Waste Management Manager.

Sustainable Waste Operations & Infrastructure

  • Support waste minimisation and waste diversion efforts through the correct implementation of waste streams and operational controls.
  • Assist in the deployment and operation of temporary waste management infrastructure, including interim collection points and resource recovery areas.
  • Monitor correct segregation and handling of waste streams and provide practical on-site guidance to teams and contractors.

Monitoring, Reporting & Issue Resolution

  • Conduct regular site inspections to assess operational readiness, cleanliness standards, and waste management performance.
  • Support data collection, basic reporting, and performance tracking against defined waste diversion targets.
  • Identify operational issues early and support escalation and resolution processes in coordination with the Senior Manager.
  • Contribute to post-event reviews, lessons learned, and continuous operational improvements.

Team & Contractor Coordination

  • Support on-site supervision and coordination of cleaning and waste management crews.
  • Assist with operational briefings, inductions, and coordination meetings.
  • Promote compliance with HSE requirements and safe working practices across all operations.

Your profile

  • Minimum 3–5 years of experience in cleaning, waste management, facility operations, practical sustainability or event operations.
  • Experience of working at large-scale sporting events, major events, or complex multi-venue operations is strongly preferred.
  • Practical understanding of cleaning operations, sustainable upstream and downstream management of discarded materials, and contractor-based service delivery.
  • Experience coordinating service providers and working in live operational environments.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Facility Management, Environmental Management, Sustainability, Engineering, or a related field is preferred.
  • Strong operational coordination and organisational skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in fast-paced, high-pressure event environments.
  • Clear communication skills and ability to work across multiple stakeholders.
  • Problem-solving mindset with a hands-on, solution-oriented approach.
  • Good reporting and documentation skills.
  • Working knowledge of HSE principles related to cleaning and waste operations.
  • Willingness to travel extensively between FIFA Official Sites
  • Flexibility to work irregular hours, including match days and peak operational periods
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Treinamento e Conscientização:

Parcerias e Alinhamento Estratégico:

  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Job Purpose

The Senior Accountant, Accruals & Expenses, plays a critical role in ensuring the accuracy and integrity of Howard University’s expense‑related financial activities. This position is responsible for reviewing the accounting worktags on invoices, requisitions and other spending; preparing monthly expense accrual entries; analyzing prepaid expenses, expense activity, and reconciling the related general ledger accounts. The Senior Associate partners with Procurement, Accounts Payable, Capital Projects, Budgets and departmental administrators to ensure that expenses are properly recorded in compliance with Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP), University policy, and internal control standards. This role requires strong analytical capabilities, excellent problem‑solving skills, sound accounting judgment, and the ability to interpret contracts and operational data to determine proper accounting treatment. The Senior Accountant will also support the monthly, quarterly, and annual close and audit processes.

Supervisory Authority

None.

Nature and Scope

Internal contacts include staff within the Controller’s Office, Procurement, Accounts Payable, Budget Office, and departmental administrators, and other departments within the university. External contacts include auditors and consultants.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Review the accounting worktags on new invoices, requisitions and other spending to ensure accurate accounting classification and adequate supporting documentation.
  • Prepare monthly accrual entries across administrative and academic units, ensuring accuracy and compliance with GAAP and University guidelines.
  • Maintain detailed accrual schedules, reconciliations, and supporting documentation.
  • Analyze expense trends and variances, propose journal entries, and ensure completeness and accuracy of liabilities.
  • Assist with expense‑related budget vs. actual reviews for the Controller’s Office and institutional departments.
  • Prepare and record prepaid expenses and monthly amortization schedules.
  • Maintain and reconcile prepaid expense ledgers for accuracy and completeness.
  • Ensure prepaid transactions comply with the University’s capitalization and expense recognition policies.
  • Prepare journal entries, reconciliations, roll‑forward schedules, and supporting analytics for monthly close.
  • Perform account analyses to identify errors, omissions, or inconsistencies, recommending corrective actions where needed.
  • Support the preparation of quarterly and annual financial reporting focused on accruals, expenses, and liabilities (i.e. variance analysis).
  • Assist with expense recognition assessments, ensuring appropriate accounting treatment.

Contract & Policy Review

  • Review contracts, agreements, purchase orders, and vendor documentation to interpret accounting implications.
  • Conduct accounting research and prepare clear, concise technical memos documenting decisions in accordance with GAAP/FASB.
  • Ensure adherence to university accounting policies, procurement policies, and applicable regulatory requirements.

Internal Controls, Compliance & Audit Support

  • Ensure accuracy, proper approvals, documentation, and compliance across all expense‑related transactions.
  • Support internal and external audit requests by preparing reconciliations, schedules, and explanations.
  • Help identify gaps in internal controls and suggest improvements to enhance financial accuracy and efficiency.

Collaboration & Cross‑Functional Support

  • Partner with Accounts Payable, Procurement, Capital Projects, Budget, and operational departments to support efficient financial processes.
  • When needed, provide guidance to departments on proper accounting practices, expense classification, and policy interpretation.
  • Assist the Accounting Manager and Assistant Director with special analyses, process improvements, and system initiatives (including Workday enhancements).

Other Duties

  • Perform critical self‑review of work to ensure high quality and accuracy.
  • Support various special projects and other responsibilities as assigned by management.

Core Competencies

  • Strong understanding of GAAP (including accrual accounting and expense recognition)
  • Experience with expense accounting, accruals, reconciliations, and monthly close processes
  • Proficiency with ERP systems (Workday is a plus)
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (VLOOKUPs, pivot tables, data analysis, macros)
  • Exceptional analytical, critical thinking and problem‑solving skills
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines
  • High level of accuracy, organization, and attention to detail

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting or finance
  • Minimum 4–6 years of progressive accounting experience, preferably in a complex environment
  • Experience with accounting for accruals and expenses
  • Workday or large ERP system experience strongly preferred.
  • Ability to work independently, take initiative, and meet strict deadlines.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$105,000-$115,000

title: Quality Commercial Enablement Jr Manager
description:
About The Company

Se para você a tecnologia existe para melhorar o caminho da vida, para o nosso time também: Seu Caminho, Nossa Jornada. Acreditamos na tecnologia que conecta gente boa no que faz e que vive a diversidade para criar e compartilhar até os caminhos que a gente (ainda!) nem sabe quais são. Trabalhamos para gerar valor não só para os nossos usuários, mas, sobretudo, para as comunidades que servimos e toda a sociedade, tornando a vida das pessoas melhor com serviços que facilitem seu dia a dia - seja com serviços de mobilidade e entrega (99) ou pagamentos digitais (99Pay).

Para facilitar a vida de milhões de pessoas todos os dias, desde 2018 fazemos parte da DiDi Global Inc., a maior plataforma de tecnologia e transporte por aplicativo do mundo. Somos pioneiros na criação de soluções inovadoras que começam no Brasil e que ganham escala para gerar impacto positivo em mais de 12 países em que a DiDi está presente. Essas inovações passam por sustentabilidade, segurança, inteligência artificial, mercado financeiro e um tanto mais.

Seja para construir projetos do zero ou aprimorar nossas soluções, gostamos de desafios que nos fazem sentir frio na barriga, e é por isso que trabalhamos num ritmo acelerado, com respeito, colaboração e bom humor. Nessa jornada, também nos fortalecemos nas diferentes vivências e opiniões para crescermos juntos, errar rápido, aprender e ajustar o caminho para criar soluções que tragam ainda melhores resultados.

About The Team/role

You will join, as an individual contributor, the newly established Commercial Quality team within our Commercial Enablement structure at 99Food, an operation committed to scaling high-performance field sales with the right skills, consistency, and impact. Your mission is to act as the "quality gatekeeper", monitoring everything that may go wrong in the sales operation, from skill execution to system usage and process adherence, and ensuring rapid diagnosis and correction. This role combines on-the-ground observation, data-driven auditing, and strategic feedback, driving immediate action and long-term improvement in our sales engine.

In this role, you'll be...

  • Design, implement, and own a comprehensive Sales Quality framework, including deep-dive audits, scorecards (technical, behavioral, process, system use), and structured feedback mechanisms.
  • Conduct audits across the commercial journey, observing field visits, CRM/system logs, demos, emails, and adherence to playbooks, to identify deviations and opportunities.
  • Manage with the team, frequent field visits alongside Business Developers to observe live execution, assess coaching needs, and validate actual vs. documented behavior.
  • Analyze usage patterns in CRMs and other commercial tools to detect gaps, underutilization, or misuse, feeding insights back into training, KB, and process improvement.
  • Act as a guardian of excellence: monitor compliance with playbooks, process flow, KB, and use of tools, and ensure alignment for every BD interaction.
  • Collaborate with Sales Enablement, Product, Operations, and Tech teams to translate QA findings into enhancements, improving Knowledge Base, training modules, workflows, and system improvements.
  • Produce recurring reports on QA insights, emerging gaps, trends, and prioritized recommendations for rapid corrective action and strategic evolution.
  • Coach and mentor QA Specialists, promoting a culture of continuous improvement, consistency, and data-based quality execution.
  • Advocate for operational, process, and systemic improvements with a hypothesis-driven mindset, strong alignment with broader Quality Control principles.

We're eager to be in touch because you have...

  • A minimum of 5–7 years of experience in quality management, process auditing, Sales QA, especially in field sales, tech, or scaling environments.
  • Proven ability to design robust QA frameworks, including scorecards, performance grids, audit routines, and escalation pathways.
  • High analytical capacity: you convert both quantitative data (CRM, metrics, dashboards) and qualitative observations (field, demos) into actionable insights.
  • Experience with CRM platforms, site/system usage tracking, and understanding of how systems impact commercial behavior.
  • Hands-on mindset and physical presence: comfortable conducting field visits, in-person assessments, and working closely with on-the-ground teams.

title: Stadium Guest Operations Manager
description:
Overview

Department: Ticketing, Hospitality & Stadium Revenue

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Guest Operations Stadium Manager is responsible for the planning, coordination, and delivery of seamless V/VIP guest services and operations within the stadiums for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027, in close collaboration with FIFA Zurich, internal FIFA27 teams, and external stakeholders. The role acts as the primary point of reference for all stadium guest operations, ensuring efficient planning, staff readiness, and high-quality service delivery during match operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the planning, coordination, and delivery of V/VIP services and guest operations across assigned stadiums.
  • Establish, manage, and coordinate stadium-level Guest Operations teams, ensuring clear task allocation in line with the event scope.
  • Support the Guest Operations Senior Manager in the development and implementation of Concepts of Operations, policies, and procedures.
  • Communicate guest management policies, stadium operational plans, and updates to all relevant internal and external stakeholders.
  • Ensure management of V/VIP Guests (local & international) is according to agreed operational plans.
  • Ensure agreed service levels are consistently delivered in collaboration with internal departments, service providers, and partners.
  • Work in close collaboration with the Guest Experience Manager on the planning and delivery of V/VIP catering services and lounge experience within the stadium environment.
  • Develop, monitor, and manage key milestones, activity schedules, and workflows, ensuring clear prioritisation and timely delivery.
  • Contribute to budget planning and support the monitoring and review of stadium guest operations expenditures.
  • Plan and deliver stadium-specific V/VIP operations training for Guest Operations Stadium staff, volunteers, hosts, and hostesses.

Your Profile

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality Management, Event Management, Tourism, Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, or a related field.
  • A Master’s degree in a relevant discipline is considered an asset.

Experience

  • Minimum 5 years’ experience in Guest Operations, Event Services, Protocol, or Hospitality operations within major events, preferably international sports events.
  • Proven experience in stadium or venue-based operations, including V/VIP services and multi-stakeholder environments.
  • Demonstrated project management experience, including planning, coordination, and operational delivery.
  • Experience working with multiple service providers and cross-functional teams in complex operational settings.
  • Experience in budget planning, cost monitoring, and financial tracking is desirable.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong organisational, planning, and prioritisation skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proven ability to drive operational excellence and deliver high-quality guest services through structured processes and teamwork.
  • Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build effective working relationships at all levels.
  • High level of attention to detail, problem-solving ability, and sound judgement under pressure.
  • Good understanding of organisational processes, governance, and operational policies.
  • Solid financial awareness, including budget management and cost control.

Certifications & Requirements

  • Project Management certification or equivalent experience is an advantage.
  • Willingness to work irregular hours, including evenings, weekends, and event days, as required by the tournament schedule.
  • Ability to work in a multicultural and international environment.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro.

  • Experiência em construção de templates de apresentações executivas.

Como requisitos desejáveis, buscamos:

title: Business Development Manager (Sports Medicine) - Rio de Janeiro
description:
medtechrec is partnered with a growing, privately held global medical device organisation specialising in sports medicine to recruit a Product Specialist to support continued expansion across Brazil.

The organisation operates internationally and combines strong commercial growth with a collaborative, people-led culture. This role sits at the centre of the regional commercial strategy and plays a critical part in supporting clinicians, partners, and internal stakeholders.

Position Overview

The Product Specialist acts as the key link between the companys product portfolio, its commercial partners, and the clinical community. As the regional subject-matter expert, the role combines deep product knowledge, market intelligence, and partner enablement to ensure solutions are clearly understood, effectively positioned, and confidently adopted.

Working closely with the Business Development Manager, the Product Specialist supports regional sales strategy through technical expertise, pricing insight, and strong relationship management.

Key Responsibilities

Product Expertise & Market Insight

  • Serve as the regional product expert, maintaining in-depth knowledge of product features, clinical applications, and supporting evidence.
  • Monitor competitive activity and market trends to support pricing strategy and commercial decision-making.
  • Provide data-driven insights to the Business Development Manager on pricing opportunities and challenges.

Partner & Customer Enablement

  • Support distributor partners in developing and executing effective go-to-market strategies.
  • Deliver structured product training and technical presentations to partners, clinicians, and internal teams.
  • Act as the first point of contact for complex clinical or technical product enquiries.

Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with distributors, partners, and end-user clinicians.
  • Represent the organisation professionally in the field, acting as a consistent brand ambassador.

Sales & Strategic Support

  • Collaborate closely with the Business Development Manager to support regional sales planning and execution.
  • Provide technical and clinical support throughout the sales cycle to progress commercial opportunities.
  • Prepare technical documentation and support responses for tenders.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Marketing to support the development of sales tools, campaigns, and educational materials.
  • Partner with Product Management to relay structured field insights that inform future product development.
  • Ensure effective communication of market and customer feedback to internal stakeholders.

Candidate Profile

  • Bachelors degree in Business, Life Sciences, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum of 3 years experience in a Product Specialist, clinical support, or similar role within sports medicine.
  • Strong ability to communicate complex technical or clinical information clearly and persuasively.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to translate market data into actionable insights.
  • Proactive, organised, and comfortable operating autonomously in a field-based role.
  • Fluent in Portuguese; English proficiency is a strong advantage.

Whats on Offer

  • Competitive salary with performance-based bonus.
  • Opportunity to play a pivotal role in a high-growth international medical device organisation.
  • Supportive, collaborative working environment.
  • Clear scope for professional development and long-term career progression.

title: Suporte de TI – Nível 2
description:
Cargo: Analista de Suporte de TI

Área: Tecnologia da Informação
Nível: Pleno / Sênior
Experiência mínima: 4 anos em Suporte Técnico, Infraestrutura ou Redes

A NAS IT está em busca de um Analista de Suporte N2 com perfil técnico e analítico, capaz de atuar em ambientes corporativos de missão crítica. O profissional será responsável por diagnosticar, resolver e documentar incidentes de nível intermediário e avançado em redes, servidores, segurança e conectividade, além de apoiar o time N1 e contribuir para a evolução contínua dos ambientes sob gestão. Esperamos um profissional autônomo, proativo e comunicativo, com domínio em Mikrotik, Fortinet, Zabbix, Grafana e soluções UniFi (Ubiquiti), além de boa compreensão de arquiteturas em nuvem e boas práticas de segurança.

Responsabilidades

  • Atuar no suporte de 2º nível, assumindo chamados escalonados e incidentes de maior complexidade;
  • Diagnosticar e resolver falhas em redes LAN/WAN, servidores e serviços corporativos;
  • Configurar e administrar roteadores Mikrotik, com foco em roteamento dinâmico (OSPF/BGP), Load Balance, Failover, QoS e segurança;
  • Implementar, gerenciar e otimizar firewalls Fortinet (FortiGate), com análise e relatórios via FortiAnalyzer;
  • Gerenciar e manter monitoramento proativo com Zabbix e Grafana, incluindo alertas, KPIs e dashboards de desempenho;
  • Instalar e configurar Access Points UniFi (Ubiquiti), realizando o gerenciamento via UniFi Controller e integração com VLANs e redes segmentadas;
  • Realizar troubleshooting de conectividade, latência, VPNs e balanceamento de carga;
  • Criar e manter políticas de backup, restore e documentação de ambientes;
  • Gerenciar Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, GPOs e permissões de acesso;
  • Apoiar a equipe N1, fornecendo direcionamento técnico e validando correções aplicadas;
  • Executar tarefas de automação, scripts e integrações que otimizem a operação;
  • Contribuir com a padronização e evolução dos ambientes de TI sob gestão da NAS IT.

Requisitos

  • Ensino Superior completo ou cursando em Redes de Computadores, Segurança da Informação, Gestão da Tecnologia da Informação, Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência mínima de 4 anos em suporte técnico ou infraestrutura corporativa;

Conhecimento avançado em

  • Mikrotik RouterOS – roteamento dinâmico (OSPF/BGP), Load Balance, Failover, QoS, firewall e VPN;
  • Fortinet FortiGate e FortiAnalyzer – políticas, UTM, SD-WAN, VPN, análise de logs e relatórios;
  • Zabbix e Grafana – configuração de templates, triggers, dashboards e alertas automatizados;
  • Ubiquiti UniFi – controladora, provisionamento de APs, VLANs e redes segmentadas;
  • Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, File Server e políticas de grupo (GPOs);
  • Microsoft 365, Azure e ambientes híbridos em nuvem;
  • Windows Server, Linux e virtualização (VMware/Hyper-V).

Diferenciais

  • Certificações: MTCNA / MTCRE, Fortinet NSE 3+, Zabbix Certified Specialist, UniFi Network Specialist;
  • Experiência com PowerShell, automação de tarefas, API e scripts de integração;
  • Vivência em ambientes gerenciados (MSP/NOC/SOC);
  • Conhecimento em políticas de segurança da informação e LGPD;
  • Inglês técnico intermediário.

Competências Comportamentais

  • Perfil analítico e orientado à resolução de problemas;
  • Capacidade de documentar e padronizar procedimentos técnicos;
  • Boa comunicação e postura profissional com clientes corporativos;
  • Foco em melhoria contínua e colaboração com o time.

Benefícios

  • Vale Refeição / Alimentação;
  • Day Off no aniversário;
  • Trabalho home office em escala programada;
  • Vale Transporte ou auxílio deslocamento;
  • Ambiente de inovação, aprendizado contínuo e crescimento profissional.
